parts.name: Timing belt
parts.does: A toothed rubber belt that keeps the crankshaft and camshaft(s) turning in step, so the valves open at the right moment.
parts.signs: Usually no warning. Cracks or missing teeth on inspection, a whine or tick from the front of the engine. If it snaps on many engines the valves hit the pistons.
parts.interval: Commonly 40,000–100,000 miles or 4–10 years, whichever comes first; age matters as much as miles.
parts.tools: Engine locking pins, torque wrench, socket set, tensioner tool
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Timing chain
parts.does: A metal chain doing the timing belt's job, inside the engine and oiled by it.
parts.signs: A rattle for a few seconds after a cold start, a cam/crank timing fault light, rough running.
parts.interval: Meant to last the engine's life; replaced when stretched, often 80,000–150,000 miles on weaker designs.
parts.tools: Engine locking kit, torque wrench, socket set, gasket sealant
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Auxiliary (drive) belt
parts.does: A ribbed belt that drives the alternator, the water pump on some engines, the power steering pump and the air-con compressor.
parts.signs: Squeal on start-up or in the wet, glazed or cracked ribs, battery light if it slips off.
parts.interval: Inspect every service; replace about every 40,000–60,000 miles or when cracked.
parts.tools: Socket set or tensioner bar, torch
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Belt tensioner and idler pulleys
parts.does: Hold the right tension on a belt and guide its route.
parts.signs: Rumble or squeak that changes with engine speed, a pulley that wobbles or feels rough when spun by hand.
parts.interval: Usually changed with the belt they run.
parts.tools: Socket set, tensioner bar
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Cylinder head gasket
parts.does: Seals the joint between the cylinder head and the block, keeping combustion, oil and coolant apart.
parts.signs: White sweet-smelling exhaust smoke, coolant loss with no leak, mayonnaise under the oil cap, overheating, bubbles in the expansion tank.
parts.interval: No interval; fails after overheating or with age.
parts.tools: Torque wrench and angle gauge, new head bolts, straight edge, full socket set
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Engine mounts
parts.does: Rubber-and-metal blocks that hold the engine to the body and soak up its vibration.
parts.signs: Clunk when pulling away or changing gear, heavy vibration at idle, the engine rocking visibly when revved.
parts.interval: Typically 60,000–100,000 miles; check when knocks appear.
parts.tools: Jack and block of wood, socket set, torque wrench
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Rocker cover gasket
parts.does: Seals the top cover of the engine so oil stays in.
parts.signs: Oil weeping down the side of the engine, burning-oil smell after a drive, oil in the spark plug wells.
parts.interval: No interval; replace when it leaks.
parts.tools: Socket set, torque wrench, cleaning cloth
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Turbocharger
parts.does: Uses exhaust gas to spin a compressor that pushes more air into the engine for more power.
parts.signs: Whistle or siren noise, blue smoke, loss of power, limp mode, oil in the intake pipes.
parts.interval: No interval; lasts longest with clean oil and a short idle after hard driving.
parts.tools: Full socket set, new oil feed and gaskets, torque wrench
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Air filter
parts.does: Stops dust and grit getting into the engine with the air it breathes.
parts.signs: Dirty or blocked element, slight loss of performance, worse economy.
parts.interval: Typically every 20,000–40,000 miles; sooner in dusty places.
parts.tools: Screwdriver or none
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: EGR valve
parts.does: Feeds a little exhaust gas back into the intake to cut nitrogen oxides.
parts.signs: Engine light, rough idle, black smoke, flat spots when accelerating.
parts.interval: No interval; cleaned or replaced when it sticks.
parts.tools: Socket set, new gasket, cleaner, code reader
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Fuel filter
parts.does: Catches dirt and water before fuel reaches the injectors; vital on a diesel.
parts.signs: Hard starting, hesitation, loss of power under load; a water warning light on some diesels.
parts.interval: Diesel: about every 20,000–40,000 miles. Petrol: often a lifetime part in the tank, or 30,000–60,000 miles.
parts.tools: Spanners or quick-release tool, drip tray, priming bulb on diesels
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Fuel pump
parts.does: Pushes fuel from the tank to the engine at the pressure it needs.
parts.signs: Whine from the tank, long cranking before a start, cutting out when hot, no start.
parts.interval: No interval.
parts.tools: Socket set, lock-ring tool, new seal
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Fuel injectors
parts.does: Spray a measured mist of fuel into the engine at exactly the right moment.
parts.signs: Misfire, rough idle, smoke, a fuel smell, a diesel knock or poor economy.
parts.interval: No interval; diesel injectors often need attention after 100,000 miles.
parts.tools: Injector puller (diesel), new seals, torque wrench, diagnostic tool
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Throttle body
parts.does: The valve that lets air into a petrol engine as the accelerator is pressed.
parts.signs: Erratic idle, stalling when coming to a stop, a dirty black throat.
parts.interval: Clean if the idle is poor; no fixed interval.
parts.tools: Screwdriver, throttle-body cleaner, code reader to relearn idle
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Glow plugs
parts.does: Heat the combustion chamber of a diesel so it starts from cold.
parts.signs: Hard cold starts, white smoke for the first minute, a flashing glow-plug light.
parts.interval: Often 60,000–100,000 miles.
parts.tools: Deep socket, torque wrench, multimeter, copper grease
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Spark plugs
parts.does: Make the spark that lights the fuel and air in a petrol engine.
parts.signs: Misfire, rough idle, hard starting, worse economy.
parts.interval: Typically every 20,000–60,000 miles depending on the plug type.
parts.tools: Spark plug socket, extension, torque wrench, gap gauge
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Ignition coil (coil pack)
parts.does: Turns 12 volts into the many thousands of volts a spark plug needs.
parts.signs: A misfire on one cylinder, flashing engine light, judder under load, especially when damp.
parts.interval: No interval.
parts.tools: Socket set, code reader
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: HT leads
parts.does: Carry the high voltage from the coil or distributor to the plugs on older engines.
parts.signs: Misfire in damp weather, cracks or tracking marks, faint clicking at night.
parts.interval: Around every 40,000–60,000 miles or when cracked.
parts.tools: Hands, lead pliers
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Distributor cap and rotor arm
parts.does: On older engines, sends the spark to each cylinder in turn.
parts.signs: Misfire, hard starting in the wet, worn or burnt contacts inside the cap.
parts.interval: Around every 20,000–40,000 miles on cars that have them.
parts.tools: Screwdriver
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Crankshaft position sensor
parts.does: Tells the engine computer where the crank is and how fast it is turning.
parts.signs: Cuts out when warm then restarts when cool, no start, rev counter dropping to zero.
parts.interval: No interval.
parts.tools: Socket set, multimeter, code reader
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Radiator
parts.does: Sheds engine heat into the air passing through it.
parts.signs: Overheating, coolant leaks or crust on the fins, cold spots felt across it.
parts.interval: No interval; often 8–15 years.
parts.tools: Socket set, drip tray, hose clip pliers
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Water pump
parts.does: Circulates coolant through the engine and radiator.
parts.signs: Coolant drips from its weep hole, a whine or grumble, overheating.
parts.interval: Often changed with the timing belt where the belt drives it.
parts.tools: Socket set, new gasket, coolant, torque wrench
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Thermostat
parts.does: A valve that keeps coolant in the engine until it is warm, then opens to the radiator.
parts.signs: Temperature gauge that stays low or climbs too high, poor heater output.
parts.interval: No interval; often replaced at a coolant change on older cars.
parts.tools: Socket set, drip tray, new seal, coolant
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Coolant hoses
parts.does: Rubber pipes carrying coolant between engine, radiator and heater.
parts.signs: Swollen, soft or cracked hoses, wet joints, steam, a sweet smell.
parts.interval: Check every service; many last 8–10 years.
parts.tools: Hose clip pliers, screwdriver, drip tray
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Expansion tank and cap
parts.does: Holds spare coolant and keeps the system at the right pressure.
parts.signs: Cracked or brown-stained tank, coolant pushed out when hot, a cap whose seal has hardened.
parts.interval: No interval.
parts.tools: Hands, drip tray
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Radiator cooling fan
parts.does: Pulls air through the radiator when the car is slow or standing.
parts.signs: Overheating in traffic, the fan never running, a fan that runs all the time.
parts.interval: No interval.
parts.tools: Socket set, multimeter
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Coolant (antifreeze)
parts.does: Carries heat, stops freezing and protects the engine's metals from corrosion.
parts.signs: Level dropping, rusty or muddy colour, weak protection on a tester.
parts.interval: Typically every 2–5 years depending on the type.
parts.tools: Drip tray, funnel, hydrometer or refractometer
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Engine oil
parts.does: Coats moving parts, carries heat away and holds dirt until it is drained.
parts.signs: Level falling, black or gritty oil, an oil warning light, ticking noises.
parts.interval: Typically every 6,000–18,000 miles or every year; check the level monthly.
parts.tools: Sump plug spanner, drip tray, funnel, new washer
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Oil filter
parts.does: Strains dirt out of the oil as it circulates.
parts.signs: None by itself; always changed with the oil.
parts.interval: With every oil change.
parts.tools: Filter wrench, drip tray
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Sump and drain plug
parts.does: The pan under the engine that holds the oil, and the plug it drains from.
parts.signs: Drips under the engine, a stripped plug thread, a dent from a kerb or speed bump.
parts.interval: Change the plug washer every oil change.
parts.tools: Spanner, new washer, torque wrench
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Oil pressure switch
parts.does: Turns on the oil light when pressure drops too low.
parts.signs: Oil light flickering at idle, an oily leak around the switch.
parts.interval: No interval.
parts.tools: Deep socket, multimeter
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Catalytic converter
parts.does: Turns the worst exhaust gases into less harmful ones.
parts.signs: Rattle from loose insides, rotten-egg smell, failed emissions test, engine light.
parts.interval: No interval; often 100,000 miles or more.
parts.tools: Axle stands, penetrating oil, socket set
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Diesel particulate filter (DPF)
parts.does: Traps soot from a diesel and burns it off from time to time.
parts.signs: DPF warning light, limp mode, more frequent regenerations, worse economy.
parts.interval: No interval; long runs help it clean itself.
parts.tools: Diagnostic tool for a forced regeneration
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Lambda (oxygen) sensor
parts.does: Measures oxygen in the exhaust so the engine computer can trim the fuel.
parts.signs: Engine light, worse economy, failed emissions test.
parts.interval: Often 60,000–100,000 miles.
parts.tools: Lambda socket, penetrating oil, code reader
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Silencer and exhaust pipes
parts.does: Carry gases away from the car and quieten them.
parts.signs: Blowing or roaring noise, rattles, holes or heavy rust, fumes in the cabin.
parts.interval: No interval; rust is the enemy.
parts.tools: Axle stands, exhaust clamps, penetrating oil, saw
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Exhaust mounting rubbers
parts.does: Hang the exhaust under the car and stop it knocking.
parts.signs: Knocks over bumps, the exhaust hanging low or touching the body.
parts.interval: When perished.
parts.tools: Pliers or prise bar
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Clutch kit
parts.does: The friction plate, pressure plate and release bearing that join and part the engine and the gearbox.
parts.signs: Slipping (revs rise but speed does not), a high biting point, judder pulling away, a whirr when the pedal is pressed.
parts.interval: No interval; commonly 60,000–120,000 miles depending on driving.
parts.tools: Transmission jack, alignment tool, torque wrench, full socket set
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Clutch cable or hydraulics
parts.does: Carries the pedal's movement to the clutch, by cable or by fluid in a master and slave cylinder.
parts.signs: Heavy or stiff pedal, a pedal that sinks to the floor, gears hard to select.
parts.interval: Hydraulic clutches often share the brake fluid reservoir; change the fluid with the brakes'.
parts.tools: Spanners, bleed kit, brake fluid
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Dual-mass flywheel
parts.does: A two-part flywheel that smooths engine pulses, common on diesels.
parts.signs: Rattle at idle that stops when the clutch is pressed, judder, knocking when switching off.
parts.interval: No interval; often replaced with the clutch.
parts.tools: As for a clutch, plus new flywheel bolts
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Gearbox oil
parts.does: Lubricates the gears and synchromesh inside the gearbox.
parts.signs: Whine, notchy changes, leaks from seals.
parts.interval: Often called filled for life; many owners change it every 60,000–100,000 miles.
parts.tools: Hex or square key, fluid pump, drip tray
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: CV joints and boots
parts.does: Let the driveshafts turn the wheels while they steer and move up and down.
parts.signs: Clicking on full lock, grease flung inside the wheel, a split rubber boot.
parts.interval: No interval; check the boots every service.
parts.tools: Hub nut socket, ball joint splitter, boot kit and grease
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Propshaft and centre bearing
parts.does: On rear-wheel-drive cars, carries drive from the gearbox to the rear axle.
parts.signs: Vibration at speed, a clunk when taking up drive, a worn rubber coupling.
parts.interval: No interval.
parts.tools: Socket set, axle stands
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Brake pads
parts.does: Friction blocks that squeeze the brake disc to slow the car.
parts.signs: Squeal from the wear indicator, grinding, a warning light, longer stopping.
parts.interval: Front often 20,000–40,000 miles; rear lasts longer.
parts.tools: Jack, axle stands, piston wind-back tool, torque wrench, brake cleaner
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Brake discs
parts.does: The metal rotors the pads grip.
parts.signs: Judder through the pedal, a lip at the edge, deep grooves, thickness under the minimum stamped on the disc.
parts.interval: Often every second set of pads.
parts.tools: As for pads, plus an impact driver for the disc screw
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Brake calipers
parts.does: Hold the pads and push them against the disc with hydraulic pressure.
parts.signs: Pulling to one side, a hot wheel, uneven pad wear, a sticking piston.
parts.interval: No interval.
parts.tools: Spanners, hose clamp, bleed kit
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Brake fluid
parts.does: Transmits the pedal's force to every brake; it absorbs water over time.
parts.signs: Spongy pedal, dark fluid, a high water reading on a tester.
parts.interval: Typically every 2 years.
parts.tools: Bleed kit, ring spanner, clear tube, fresh sealed fluid
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Brake shoes and drums
parts.does: Rear brakes on many small cars: shoes push out against the inside of a drum.
parts.signs: Weak handbrake, scraping, a lip on the drum, uneven braking at the rear.
parts.interval: Often 40,000–80,000 miles.
parts.tools: Drum puller, spring pliers, brake cleaner
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Handbrake cable
parts.does: Pulls on the rear brakes to hold the car still.
parts.signs: Lever travels too far, car rolls on a hill, a seized cable that leaves a brake on.
parts.interval: Adjust as needed; replace when seized.
parts.tools: Spanners, axle stands
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Brake hoses and pipes
parts.does: Carry brake fluid from the master cylinder to each wheel.
parts.signs: Rusty pipes, cracked or bulging hoses, fluid leaks, a soft pedal.
parts.interval: Inspect every service and MOT.
parts.tools: Brake pipe flaring tool, spanners, bleed kit
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Shock absorbers (dampers)
parts.does: Calm the springs so the car does not keep bouncing after a bump.
parts.signs: Floaty ride, bouncing after bumps, oil misting on the body, uneven tyre wear.
parts.interval: Often 50,000–100,000 miles.
parts.tools: Spring compressors, socket set, torque wrench
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Coil springs
parts.does: Hold the car's weight and absorb bumps.
parts.signs: A broken coil, one corner sitting low, a clonk over bumps.
parts.interval: No interval; often break in pothole season.
parts.tools: Spring compressors, socket set
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Anti-roll bar links
parts.does: Join the anti-roll bar to the suspension so the car leans less in corners.
parts.signs: Knock or rattle over small bumps, play in a link's joint.
parts.interval: No interval; cheap and common.
parts.tools: Spanners, hex key to hold the stud
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Wishbones (control arms) and bushes
parts.does: Locate the wheel and let it move up and down; the rubber bushes absorb shocks.
parts.signs: Clunks, vague steering, a wobble under braking, split rubber in the bushes.
parts.interval: No interval.
parts.tools: Ball joint splitter, socket set, torque wrench
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Ball joints
parts.does: Pivot points between the suspension arms and the hub.
parts.signs: Knock over bumps, play when the wheel is rocked top to bottom, a split boot.
parts.interval: No interval.
parts.tools: Ball joint splitter, socket set
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Top mounts
parts.does: Bearings at the top of the strut that let it turn as the car steers.
parts.signs: Clunk or creak when steering, a knock over bumps.
parts.interval: Often replaced with the shock absorbers.
parts.tools: Spring compressors, socket set
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Wheel bearings
parts.does: Let the wheel spin freely on its hub.
parts.signs: A hum or rumble that rises with speed and changes when cornering, play in the wheel.
parts.interval: No interval.
parts.tools: Hub puller or press, hub nut socket, torque wrench
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Track rod ends
parts.does: The outer joints of the steering that turn the wheel hub.
parts.signs: Knock over bumps, play in the steering, uneven tyre wear, an MOT advisory.
parts.interval: No interval; needs a wheel alignment afterwards.
parts.tools: Ball joint splitter, spanners
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Steering rack
parts.does: Turns the steering wheel's rotation into the sideways push that steers.
parts.signs: Leaks, knocking through the wheel, play or stiffness.
parts.interval: No interval.
parts.tools: Full socket set, alignment afterwards
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Power steering pump and fluid
parts.does: On hydraulic systems, pumps fluid that does most of the work of steering.
parts.signs: Whine on full lock, heavy steering, leaks, low fluid.
parts.interval: Check the level every service; some makers never ask for a change.
parts.tools: Socket set, fluid of the right specification
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Electric power steering motor
parts.does: Assists the steering with an electric motor instead of a hydraulic pump.
parts.signs: Steering suddenly heavy, a warning light, a notchy feel.
parts.interval: No interval.
parts.tools: Diagnostic tool
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Battery
parts.does: Starts the car and steadies the electrical supply.
parts.signs: Slow cranking, clicking, dim lights at start, a battery light.
parts.interval: Often 4–7 years.
parts.tools: Spanners, terminal brush, memory saver
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Alternator
parts.does: Charges the battery and powers the car while the engine runs.
parts.signs: Battery light, dim or pulsing lights, a flat battery, a whine.
parts.interval: No interval; often 80,000–150,000 miles.
parts.tools: Socket set, belt tool, multimeter
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Starter motor
parts.does: Turns the engine over to start it.
parts.signs: Click but no crank, grinding, a slow or intermittent start.
parts.interval: No interval.
parts.tools: Socket set, multimeter
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Fuses and relays
parts.does: Protect circuits and switch heavy loads.
parts.signs: One system stops working at once, a fuse that blows again.
parts.interval: No interval.
parts.tools: Fuse puller, test light
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Engine control unit (ECU)
parts.does: The computer that runs the engine's fuel and spark.
parts.signs: Rare faults: no start, many warning lights at once, odd running.
parts.interval: No interval.
parts.tools: Diagnostic tool
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Headlamp bulbs
parts.does: The dipped and main beam lights.
parts.signs: A beam out, dim yellow light, a bulb flickering.
parts.interval: When blown; changing them in pairs keeps them even.
parts.tools: Hands, gloves (never touch halogen glass)
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Indicator and brake bulbs
parts.does: Signal turns and braking.
parts.signs: Fast flashing on one side, a brake light out.
parts.interval: When blown.
parts.tools: Screwdriver
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Number plate and interior bulbs
parts.does: Light the plate at night and the cabin.
parts.signs: An unlit plate (an MOT fail), a dark cabin.
parts.interval: When blown.
parts.tools: Screwdriver
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Wiper blades
parts.does: Clear rain from the windscreen.
parts.signs: Smearing, juddering, streaks, split rubber.
parts.interval: Typically every 1–2 years.
parts.tools: Hands
parts.source: Written for @family. from general workshop knowledge; intervals are typical ranges, and the car's own service book wins.

parts.name: Door locks and central locking
parts.does: Lock and unlock the doors, often by motor.
parts.signs: One door that will not lock, buzzing in a door.
parts.interval: No interval.
